title: High specific yield strength and superior ductility of a lightweight refractory high-entropy alloy prepared by laser additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by laser directed energy deposition additive manufacturing system with 10KW fiber laser, 6-8 mm beam diameter, 5.5-6KW output power, 800-1000 g/h powder delivery rate, 1000 mm/min scanning speed in argon atmosphere. Post-processed by tempering at 600°C for 2 hours.
